review_rule: A sample counts as an answer when its text (or chat message) addresses the question, even if short and followed by an action. It is a lead-in when the text only announces or narrates the action or defers the answer; it ignores the question when the text responds to something else. For 'what next' wordings, narrating the action being taken right then is a lead-in; with tools disabled the same sentence counts. Cells are topped up by exact replay while the real-answer rate is at least about 30%, otherwise with tools disabled (no_tools).
